hints.tr: Koşul `n > 0`; gövdenin sonunda `n -= 1` olmazsa döngü hiç bitmez.
hints.en: The condition is `n > 0`; without `n -= 1` at the end of the body the loop never ends.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
n = int(input("Start: "))
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1
print("Liftoff!")
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
n = int(input("Start: "))
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1
print("Liftoff!")
```
